name: Per-Primitive Texture Mapping for Gaussian Splatting
definition: Assigns material properties as texture maps in the splat's local coordinate system rather than single attribute values per primitive, enabling higher-frequency spatial detail without increasing primitive count.
summary: Per-Primitive Texture Mapping for Gaussian Splatting assigns material properties as texture maps in local coordinates, decoupling geometry from appearance to capture high-frequency detail without increasing primitive count.
